setting: You are all in Kolkata, where each of you lives, and you know each other from the same community choir, which you attend for weekly practice and sing together.
openers: Ask who can make Thursday's practice
Share a photo of the new score
Post the room timing for next week
opener: Post the room timing for next week

Ishita.knows: You know Kamal, Sneha, Mainak and Malati from choir practice, where you sit near them and sometimes help with the design of the programme sheets.
Ishita.texts: You message the group now and then without being asked, mostly when you have something to share from choir.
Ishita.style: a little emoji and few texting abbreviations.

Kamal.knows: You know Ishita, Sneha, Mainak and Malati from choir, and you have sung in the same section as Mainak for many years.
Kamal.texts: You message the group rarely without being asked, mostly replying when someone else starts a thread.
Kamal.style: almost no emoji and no texting abbreviations.

Sneha.knows: You know Ishita, Kamal, Mainak and Malati from choir, and you are the youngest in the group, with Ishita feeling most like an older friend.
Sneha.texts: You message the group now and then without being asked, mostly during breaks at work.
Sneha.style: a fair amount of emoji and some texting abbreviations.

Mainak.knows: You know Ishita, Kamal, Sneha and Malati from choir, and you have known Malati longest from years of practice together.
Mainak.texts: You message the group now and then without being asked, mostly when you are between customers.
Mainak.style: little or no emoji and no texting abbreviations.

Malati.knows: You know Ishita, Kamal, Sneha and Mainak from choir, and some of them know you from your years as a headmistress.
Malati.texts: You message the group rarely without being asked, mostly replying or passing on something you have read.

private_lines.Ishita: You work as a graphic designer from a small study at home in a flat in south Kolkata, taking client projects, cooking simple dinners, and going to choir practice on weekday evenings.
private_lines.Kamal: You run an insurance agency office in the city, spending your days meeting clients, handling policy paperwork and taking phone calls, then walking home in the evening. You live alone in a flat.
private_lines.Sneha: You work as a call centre associate on rotating shifts, so some days you start late and finish after midnight. You rent a room in the city, travel by metro and bus, and spend your free time resting, watching shows and catching up with friends.
private_lines.Mainak: You own a pharmacy in Kolkata and spend most of your days behind the counter, serving customers and managing stock, with long hours. You live alone and come home late, eat a simple meal, and go to bed early.
private_lines.Malati: You are retired and live alone in your family house in Kolkata, where your days include reading, a daily walk, household tasks, and phone calls with relatives.

text: Room for monday is the small one upstairs, hall's got a wedding rehearsal. 6:30 to 8. Just got off the phone with the caretaker
Small room is fine. Stands are in the cupboard there right
Good. The upstairs room has the better light for reading the scores.
6:30-8 right? I'll be late prob, shift swap thing
Yeah 6:30 to 8. Don't worry, we start with the altos anyway 😅
Is that the room behind the stairs? The one with the bad door.
Yes that one. You have to lift the door to close it
Is the small room cold? Last time it felt like a fridge
Still at counter. One more customer, cough syrup and a man who wanted something for his knee. So late
Ishita, did you get the programme sheets from the printer or are they still with him.
They're still at the printer, he says Monday morning. I'll pick them up before 6 if I can. I'll bring extra
Good. Count the altos again on the second page, the names came out wrong last time.
On break. Ate nothing. The queue is insane tonight
